\subsection{Accuracy across the 85 \ucr{} datasets}
\label{sec:res:ucr}

\begin{guide}
One dataset proves nothing. This subsection shows the result holds broadly. Report
the mean accuracy, but also the win/tie/loss record, because a mean can hide a model
that wins hugely on three datasets and loses everywhere else.
\textbf{Questions to answer:} Is the difference between my model and the baseline
larger than the difference between two seeds of the same model? On which kinds of
datasets do I win or lose (long series? few training examples? many classes?)
\end{guide}
